info.desc: Hatful of Hollow is a compilation album by the English rock band The Smiths, featuring BBC Radio 1 studio recordings and two contemporary singles with their B-sides. It was released on 12 November 1984 by the band's British record company, Rough Trade, just months after the band's debut, The Smiths. The album reached No. 7 on the UK Albums Chart and stayed on the chart for 46 weeks. Eventually, on 9 November 1993, it was also released by their American label, Sire Records, which had initially declined to release the album. Sire instead released Louder Than Bombs in the US .

podcast.body: Released hastily by the record label due to strong demand after their debut album, this collection comprised singles, B-sides, and outtakes. Its release was intended to buy the band time to record another proper studio album, and it performed very well commercially. "their record label had to rush release a second album of singles and B-sides and outtakes called Hat Full of Hollow, just to buy the Smiths some time to record another proper studio album."
